name: MCPJam Backend LLM distinct FREE-allowance spenders >80/h
description: PAGE · More than 80 distinct subjects were charged against a FREE daily allowance this hour.
The abuse-shaped half of the spender count: paying customers are excluded, so real growth does not move it.
TRIAGE — open View Query below, replace the last line with:
| summarize S=round(sum(amount),2) by spendingKey, subjectKind | sort by S desc
guest:<uuid> keys dominating → guest minting · jx7… keys → signup farming
rationale: WHY THIS EXISTS: sharper than 'distinct paid spenders' (which also counts wallet customers). Free-allowance farming is by definition many subjects each spending our free money; paying customers cannot move this number. Signed-in free spenders are keyed by ORG id (nx7…), guests by guest:<uuid>.

WHY THIS THRESHOLD: measured hourly distinct free spenders 08-25..09-12: p95 per day 5-27, max 29 on ordinary days, 55-62 on two launch-shaped hours (09-06, 09-12). Abuse: 62-70/h on 09-13/14 (early), 226/h on 09-15, 153/h on 09-16. 80 sits above every legit hour and under half the main wave; the early-wave days would have produced a first message at 09-13 08Z, ~40 hours before the $5k day.

NOTE ON 'positive results': triggerAfterNPositiveResults is a DEBOUNCE (fire only after N consecutive positive checks). It makes a monitor slower, never louder; Axiom notifies once on entering the alert state and once on leaving. Page-vs-warn is decided by the notifier, not this field.
